title: "`r {source('_setup.R'); tr('overview.title')}`"

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
## Overview (SPEC.md S7.1): status cards per package, the recent download
## sample, open issues, the last release and the per-source freshness light.
##
## NG-2 is load-bearing on this page: there is no commit count anywhere on
## it, and `overview.no_commits_note` says so out loud, so the omission reads
## as a decision rather than an oversight.
##
## Every visible string comes from config/i18n.yml through tr()/tr_f();
## everything else on the page is a value read from site/_data/*.json.
##
## Kept inside this chunk rather than in an HTML comment: Pandoc passes an
## HTML comment straight through to the output, which would publish English
## developer notes inside the Portuguese page.
source("_setup.R")

meta <- zb_json("meta")
overview <- zb_json("overview")
freshness <- zb_json("freshness")

packages <- zb_df(overview$packages)
totals <- overview$totals
sources <- zb_df(freshness$sources)
```

```{r}
#| label: header
#| results: asis
zb_out(zb_page_header("index.html", zb_get(meta, "latest_data_date")))
```

`r tr("overview.lead")`

## `r tr("overview.totals.title")`

```{r}
#| label: totals
#| results: asis
zb_out(zb_kpis(list(
  list(
    label = tr("overview.totals.packages"),
    value = zb_int(zb_get(totals, "n_packages", 0L))
  ),
  list(
    label = tr("overview.totals.repos"),
    value = zb_int(zb_get(totals, "n_repos", 0L))
  ),
  list(
    label = tr("overview.totals.downloads"),
    value = zb_int(zb_get(totals, "downloads_30d", 0L)),
    # SPEC.md S7.2: the mandatory label, and a one-click path to S10.1.
    note = paste0(
      "**", tr("downloads.label"), "**. [",
      tr("downloads.limitation_link"), "](about.html#lim-1)."
    )
  ),
  list(
    label = tr("overview.totals.open_issues"),
    value = zb_int(zb_get(totals, "open_issues", 0L))
  ),
  list(
    label = tr("overview.totals.open_prs"),
    value = zb_int(zb_get(totals, "open_prs", 0L))
  ),
  list(
    label = tr("overview.totals.works"),
    value = zb_int(zb_get(totals, "n_works", 0L))
  ),
  list(
    label = tr("overview.totals.citations"),
    value = zb_int(zb_get(totals, "citations", 0L)),
    note = paste0("[", tr("common.see_limitations"), "](about.html#lim-5).")
  )
)))

zb_out(zb_note(tr("overview.no_commits_note")))
```

## `r tr("overview.packages.title")`

```{r}
#| label: package-cards
#| results: asis
if (nrow(packages) == 0L) {
  zb_out(zb_no_data(tr("overview.packages.none")))
} else {
  snapshot <- zb_get(overview, "snapshot_date")
  if (!is.na(snapshot)) {
    zb_out(zb_note(tr_f("common.snapshot_date", date = zb_date(snapshot))))
  }
  cards <- vapply(
    seq_len(nrow(packages)),
    function(i) zb_pkg_card(as.list(packages[i, , drop = FALSE])),
    character(1)
  )
  zb_out('<div class="zb-card-grid">', paste0(cards, collapse = ""), "</div>")
}
```

## `r tr("freshness.title")`

`r tr("freshness.lead")`

```{r}
#| label: freshness
#| results: asis
if (nrow(sources) == 0L) {
  zb_out(zb_no_data(tr("freshness.none")))
} else {
  sources <- sources[order(sources$source), , drop = FALSE]
  table <- data.frame(
    source = paste0("<code>", zb_esc(sources$source), "</code>"),
    status = zb_run_status(sources$status),
    run = zb_datetime(sources$run_ts),
    age = tr_f("freshness.age_hours", hours = zb_dbl(sources$age_hours, digits = 1L)),
    rows = zb_int(sources$rows_written),
    message = ifelse(is.na(sources$message), tr("common.none"), sources$message),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  zb_out(zb_table(
    table,
    labels = c(
      tr("freshness.col.source"), tr("freshness.col.status"),
      tr("freshness.col.run"), tr("freshness.col.age"),
      tr("freshness.col.rows"), tr("freshness.col.message")
    ),
    label = tr("freshness.title"),
    align = c("l", "l", "l", "r", "r", "l"),
    raw = c("source", "status")
  ))
}
```
